weeks.title: Week 1: Core Concepts
weeks.html:
Background

Pinnacle Development Solutions is a rapidly growing construction company specializing in mixed-use developments in urban markets. Founded in 2020, the company has grown from $5 million to $45 million in annual revenue. You have been hired as CFO to implement sophisticated financial systems and prepare for a potential private equity partnership.

Company Profile:

Revenue: $45 million annually

Projects: Typically $3-15 million each

Markets: Southeast urban cores

Specialties: Mixed-use, multifamily, adaptive reuse

Team: 65 employees, 200+ subcontractors

Current Situation - December 2024: The company has 6 active projects in various stages, with 3 new projects beginning in Q1 2025. The bank is requiring enhanced financial reporting, and potential private equity partners want to see sophisticated financial management systems.

Required Analysis Tasks

Task 1: Advanced WIP Schedule Preparation Prepare comprehensive WIP schedule including:

Contract modifications analysis per ASC 606

Variable consideration assessment for Project 6

Percentage complete calculations using cost-to-cost method

Revenue recognition for current period

Over/under billing analysis

Gross profit analysis and margin assessment

Task 2: Revenue Recognition and Journal Entries Calculate and prepare journal entries for:

Monthly revenue recognition adjustments

Contract asset/liability positions

Any loss recognition requirements

Variable consideration adjustments

Task 3: Retainage Analysis and Cash Flow Impact Analyze retainage positions:

Current vs. non-current classification

Aging analysis of overdue releases

Cash flow impact assessment

Optimization strategies recommendation

Task 4: Financial Statement Preparation Prepare construction-specific financial statements:

Balance sheet with proper contract asset/liability presentation

Income statement with detailed cost breakdowns

Cash flow statement highlighting construction activities

Task 5: Management Dashboard Design Create executive dashboard showing:

Project performance rankings

Exception reporting for projects requiring attention

Key performance indicators and trends

Cash flow and working capital analysis

Task 6: Strategic Recommendations Provide recommendations for:

WIP system automation opportunities

Billing process improvements

Collection optimization strategies

Financial controls enhancement

Task 6: Strategic Recommendations

Immediate Actions (Next 30 Days):

Heritage Loft Crisis Management: Conduct thorough cost review, evaluate loss recognition

WIP System Automation: Implement real-time cost tracking integration

Cash Management: Address $2.6M contract liability position

Short-term Improvements (3-6 Months):

Enhanced Financial Controls: Monthly project manager estimate reviews

Billing Process Automation: Reduce billing cycle from 10 to 5 days

Collection Optimization: Implement automated follow-up systems

Strategic Initiatives (6-12 Months):

Technology Platform Integration: Full ERP implementation

Performance Management: Implement project manager scorecards

Private Equity Preparation: Clean up processes and systems for due diligence

Critical Success Factors:

Resolve Heritage Loft issues to maintain portfolio credibility

Implement real-time project tracking for better control

Optimize cash management to support growth plans

Establish systems that scale with anticipated growth
